title: A Cellar for the Choir
author: Orsen Nakamura
blurb: Marguerite Reyes, a hospice nurse who hears the dying count backwards, documents everything, because documentation is a kind of prayer. Then the village's church bell rings although the bell was melted down in 1911 — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must get the family out ahead of the count, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
